title: Stages show the journey
summary: A stage groups related steps under a clear name. This helps people see where a run failed.
introduction: A stage groups related steps under a clear name. This helps people see where a run failed. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.title: Stages show the journey

blocks.text: The Read stage comes before Check in this sequential pipeline.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not label a stage Test if it only prints a message; the example messages are demonstrations.
For more detail later, use this [Jenkins further reading](https://www.jenkins.io/doc/book/pipeline/).
